name: 90 Day Fiancé
description: Getting through customs is just the beginning. With just 90 days to wed on a fiancé visa, follow international couples as they attempt to overcome cultural barriers and family drama while in search of true love that knows no borders.

videos.title: Where Are They Now
videos.overview: An update on the couples featured in season one.

videos.title: Where Are They Now?
videos.overview: An update on the couples from season 2

videos.title: Danielle & Mohamed: Our Journey So Far
videos.overview: Relive all the memorable moments between Danielle and her Tunisian fiancé Mohamed, from their meeting online to his arrival in the U.S.

videos.title: Melanie & Devar: Our Journey So Far
videos.overview: Season 3's Melanie and Devar recall how they met in Jamaica and the relationship that followed.

videos.title: Most OMG Moments
videos.overview: Countdown the most outrageous moments from 90 Day Fiancé and 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?. From extreme fights to romantic nights, with bombshells dropped and secrets revealed, it's a must-see bonanza that'll make you say O-M-G.

videos.title: Love is a Battlefield
videos.overview: Love is filled with ups and downs; featuring the series' most memorable altercations.

videos.overview: Reliving the memories of how Melanie and Devar fell in love in Jamaica then raced to the altar to get married in 90 days.

videos.title: Molly & Luis: Our Continuing Journey
videos.overview: Molly was sure Luis would make a wonderful father to her two girls, but his inappropriate behavior around her teenager and constant complaints about her 5-year-old threaten to put her dreams of saying "I do" on hold.

videos.title: David & Annie: Our Continuing Journey
videos.overview: Reliving David and Annie's journey; David has to borrow money to bring Annie to America; when she threatens to return to Thailand, he tries to convince her that he can give her a dream life.

videos.title: Paul & Karine: Our Journey So Far
videos.overview: Despite a cultural divide and language barrier, Paul finds love with Karine, a Brazilian from the depths of the Amazon.

videos.title: Eric & Leida: Our Journey So Far
videos.overview: A look back at the highs and lows of Eric and Leida's journey.

videos.title: 90 Day LIVE #1
videos.overview: 90 Day Fiancé is going live! Following a new episode of 90 Day Fiancé, join host Michelle Collins as she takes your social media questions and dishes the dirt with familiar guests, including Colt's mom Debbie, and Angela from Before the 90 Days.

videos.title: 90 Day LIVE #2
videos.overview: 90 Day Fiancé is going live! Following a new episode of 90 Day Fiancé, join host Michelle Collins as she takes your social media questions, and dishes out with familiar guests like Molly from Happily Ever After and Jesse from Before the 90 Days.

videos.title: Angela & Michael: Our Continuing Journey
videos.overview: A look back at Angela and Michael's journey.

videos.title: Darcey's Continuing Journey
videos.overview: A look back at Darcey's journey.

videos.title: Most Outrageous Moments
videos.overview: Relive the most outrageous 90 Day moments as we look back at some of our favorite couples. Through unforgettable arrivals, culture clashes, lies, skeptical families and relationship breakdowns, each couple has fought to find love across the globe.

videos.title: Biggest Breakups
videos.overview: Four Americans found love overseas and put it all on the line to be with the one they loved. But, not all love stories have a fairy tale ending Relive the journeys of four 90 Day couples as they say I do, or I don't.

videos.title: Secrets & Lies
videos.overview: Look back at some of the biggest reveals in 90 Day Fiancé history, including long kept secrets, legal troubles, past loves, and infidelity. The most shocking confessions will test each couple's relationship as they fight for their happily ever after.

videos.title: Family Feuds
videos.overview: Looking back at some of the biggest family feuds in 90 Day Fiance' history, from meeting their new family, to dealing with parents, sibling rivalry, and new step-kids. Family tensions come to a boiling point and each couple is tested.

videos.title: I Got My Visa!
videos.overview: Using a unique 90 Day Fiancé visa, four women will travel to the US to live with their overseas fiancés for the first time. Each couple will have just 90 days to decide to get married or send their international mate home.

videos.title: Culture Shock
videos.overview: Living with Russ' parents takes a toll on Paola while her wild ways turns up the heat with Russ's friends. Kirlyam struggles in her new setting & misses home. Aziza meets Mike's skeptical family. Louis prepares his boys and ex-wife for Aya's arrival.

videos.title: Enough is Enough
videos.overview: Russ and Paola move into their own apartment. Aya meets Louis' ex-wife & boys for the first time. Kirlyam takes a trip to a salon where Alan learns she's been referred to a modeling agency. Aziza & Mike hit a pivotal milestone in their relationship.

videos.title: 90 Days Isn't Enough
videos.overview: Russ takes Paola to a tailgate; later the couple's wedding plans are put into jeopardy. Alan is concerned as Kirlyam gets a big opportunity. Mike's Mom confronts Aziza at her bachelorette party. Aya grows upset as Louis cuts corners on their wedding.

videos.title: Didn't Expect This...
videos.overview: Mike goes AWOL after his bachelor party upsetting Aziza. Alan & Kirlyam rush to prepare for their wedding. Paola shops for a wedding dress still unsure if Russ will be called back to work. A limited budget stops Aya from having her dream wedding.

videos.title: Time's Up
videos.overview: Paola's has her bachelorette party, still unsure if her wedding will happen. Nerves get the best of Aziza before her wedding. Awkwardness ensues as virgins Kirylam and Alan consummate their wedding. Louis is late for his wedding leaving Aya in doubt.

videos.title: New Couples, New Journeys
videos.overview: Using a unique 90 Day Fiancé visa, six foreigners will travel to the US to live with their overseas fiancés for the first time. Each couple will have just 90 days to decide to get married or send their international mate home.

videos.title: I'm Home America!
videos.overview: Evelin pushes to meet Justin's family. At Yamir's album release party his manager throws his private life into the public eye. Mohamed meets Danielle's skeptical son. Daya questions her engagement ring. We meet a new couple Danny & Amy.

videos.title: Watch You Like a Hawk
videos.overview: Danny misses Amy’s first day in America. Justin shocks relatives with news of his engagement. Mohamed meets the rest of Danielle’s family.  Daya meets Brett’s daughter for the first time. And we meet a new couple Jason and Cassia.

videos.title: Touchdown!
videos.overview: Amy confronts Danny about his family. Mohamed learns the meaning of "hooking up." Jason travels to Brazil, still uncertain if Cassia will meet him. Yamir arrives in the U.S. and Chelsea’s parents have many questions about the couple’s future.

videos.title: Mo' Money, Mo' Problems
videos.overview: Danielle fears Mohamed may leave. Justin sees his family for the first time since telling his secret. Cassia and Jason fight about trust. Danny’s brother ruins date night with Amy. Yamir’s move yields devastating news.

videos.title: Fears, Family, Future
videos.overview: Justin and Evelin invite Jake and Jen over for dinner. Daya confronts Brett about Cassidy’s behavior. Amy’s mom arrives from South Africa. Yamir meets with music producers in Chicago. Jason has a surprise for Cassia.

videos.title: I Have To Tell You Something
videos.overview: Jason & Cassia struggle with budget and Jason’s work schedule. Danielle breaks bad news to Mohamed. Evelin bonds with Justin’s Mom. Brett’s skeptical friend Sue finally meets Daya. Danny hopes his conservative parents don’t offend Amy.

videos.title: Going Once, Going Twice...Gone?
videos.overview: Danny and Amy’s families meet. Cassia breaks down during a fight with Jason. Justin surprises Evelin and his mom. Mohamed visits a lawyer on his wedding day. Chelsea and Yamir discuss the future of his career. Daya and Brett go apartment hunting.

videos.title: Red Flags
videos.overview: Mohamed hopes he is making the right choice with Danielle. Danny’s brothers pass him the sex torch. Cassia confronts Jason’s brother when meeting his family for the first time. Brett’s mom confronts Brett about Daya the day before the wedding.

videos.title: I'm Gonna Go Home
videos.overview: Chelsea panics before the wedding. Jason and Cassia try to resolve their differences in Vegas. Mohamed goes AWOL on Danielle. Brett has to choose between Daya and his mom. Jason’s wedding day is not what he’d planned.

videos.title: The Couples Tell All
videos.overview: All 6 couples will meet for the first time and tell all in a revealing, emotionally charged reunion special. NBC’s Erica Hill will moderate as we learn more about the journeys of season 2's couples and find out where their relationships stand

videos.title: Departures and Arrivals
videos.overview: Using a unique visa six new couples embark on the 90-day journey. Their foreign mates will travel to the US and have 90 days to get married or leave the country. But for a few couples the adventure is on hold as they wait in limbo for visa approval.

videos.title: Welcome to the Family
videos.overview: Loren is nervous for Alexei to meet her parents. Mark is anxious for Nikki’s arrival. Devar meets Melanie’s son for the first time. Josh plans a surprise for Alexsandra's birthday. And we meet new couple Kyle and Noon.

videos.title: Questions & Answers
videos.overview: Nikki meets Mark’s daughter who is older than she is. Melanie’s sister confronts Devar about his intensions. Noon is not impressed with Kyle’s house. Loren& Alexei get final word on Alexei's visa status. And we meet new couple, Fernando and Carolina.

videos.title: Full of Surprises
videos.overview: Living together proves tough for Mark and Nikki. Aleksandra’s past shocks Josh’s family. Melanie looks for the perfect ring and meets Devar’s mom. Kyle makes a big jump to prove his love to Noon. In Colombia, Fernando has upsetting news for Carolina.

videos.title: Missing Home
videos.overview: A call home to Alexie’s parents leaves Lauren in tears. Josh’s plan to cheer Aleksandra up backfires. Nikki wonders if moving to America was the right decision. Melanie’s sisters have tough questions for Devar. Carolina shops for a wedding dress.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Drama
videos.overview: Mark is uneasy around Nikki during her “monthlies.” Loren pushes Alexei into modeling. Melanie questions Devar’s financial plan. Aleksandra hopes to feel more accepted by Josh’s parents. Noon sees a side of Kyle that she does not enjoy.

videos.title: Don't Push Me
videos.overview: Tensions rise with Fernando’s mom. Mark’s past causes problems with Nikki. Alexandra’s parents arrive in America and question the Mormon lifestlye. Noon addresses Kyle’s distance from his family and Alexei and Loren argue about his modeling career.

videos.title: Bachelorette Blues
videos.overview: Loren’s Bachelorette weekend sends Alexei over the edge. Noon finally meets Kyle’s estranged Mom. Aleksandra questions if she is too young for marriage. Nikki eyes an expensive dress in NYC. Carolina worries about Fernando’s womanizing ways.

videos.title: What Do You Know about Love?
videos.overview: Mark asks Nikki to sign a pre-nup. Loren is in tears as Alexei looks at flights home. Carolina confronts her future Mother-in-Law. Melanie can’t contain her emotions before the wedding. Josh has pre-wedding jitters & Kyle hopes his mother will show.

videos.title: This Is It
videos.overview: Nikki must decide if she wants to go through with the wedding. Loren has last minute worries on the big day. Carolina wants acceptance into Fernando’s family before the wedding. Emotion overcomes both Melanie and Devar as they prepare to wed.

videos.title: Season 3 Tell All
videos.overview: All six couples of "90 Day Fiance" meet face-to-face for the first time, sitting down with NBC's Erica Hill for a candid & revealing conversation. What happened when cameras stopped rolling? Where do their relationships stand now?

videos.title: For Your Eyes Only
videos.overview: Before the foreigners arrive, the Americans must prepare. This special episode showcases the anxiety before each relationship's 90-day clock begins - and in once case, before the decision to apply for the Visa process has even been made.

videos.title: You Say Goodbye, I Say Hello
videos.overview: The journey begins for two couples. After a bad fight Jorge wonders if he still has a fiancé. Nicole says goodbye to America and lands in Morocco to meet her fiancé Azan in person for the first time ever.

videos.title: Meet the Family
videos.overview: Alla endures a tense meeting with Matt’s family. Pedro meets Chantel’s parents, who think he’s on a student Visa. Anfisa lays out her financial demands to Jorge. Nicole may not be cut out for Moroccan culture.

videos.title: Life's A Beach
videos.overview: Matt & Alla go on a double date with Matt's skeptical friend. A nervous Nicole travels to Azan's hometown to meet his family. Pedro sees a new side of Chantel during a trip to Florida. Anfisa comes face to face with Jorge's sister.

videos.title: Testing the Waters
videos.overview: Jorge reveals a secret about his past to Anfisa. Chantel & Pedro reveal their secret to a friend. Cultural differences continue to cause trouble for Nicole & Azan. Alla enjoys time away from Matt. And we meet Narkiya whose fiancé Lowo catfished her.

videos.title: I Can See the Cracks
videos.overview: Nicole & Azan head to the desert for a big surprise. Chantel has regrets while secretly shopping for a wedding dress without her mother. Anfisa tries on a $45,000 gown. A skeptical Narkiya waits to hear from Lowo who claims his phone was stolen.

videos.title: Time to Tell the Truth
videos.overview: Anfisa pursues her dream of becoming a famous model to Jorge’s dismay. Nicole struggles to keep up with Azan on a romantic outing in the desert. Chantel reveals her secret engagement to her family. Alla is homesick. Narkyia looks for a wedding dress.

videos.title: This Is What You Came For
videos.overview: Anfisa reveals her true intentions to Jorge. Matt’s mom dashes Alla’s wedding dreams. Nicole seeks outside advice about Azan. Chantel asks her brother for forgiveness.

videos.title: You're Gonna Miss Me When I'm Gone
videos.overview: The 90-day timeline continues to put stress on the couples. Nicole & Azan make a huge decision about their relationship, Anfisa kicks Jorge out, and Chantel’s parents issue an ultimatum. We meet Lowo in Vietnam waiting on his paperwork.

videos.title: Confessions of a Foreign Fiance
videos.overview: Chantel & Pedro fight about their future. Anfisa pushes Jorge over the line. Alla makes a shocking confession. Lowo discovers that Narkiya still mistrusts him.

videos.title: Are You Ready For This?
videos.overview: Anfisa and Jorge get closer to severing ties while Chantel & Pedro argue about signing a pre-nup. Nicole’s mom begs her daughter to be reasonable. Lowo shocks Narkyia with news of their wedding. Matt & Alla prepare for their big day.

videos.title: Too Little Too Late
videos.overview: Chantel & Pedro head to the altar. Jorge & Anfisa make the final decision about their rocky relationship. Nicole gets devastating news about the K1 Visa. Narkyia discovers yet another Lowo lie that jeopardizes everything.

videos.title: Speak Now or Forever Hold Your Peace
videos.overview: Jorge and Anfisa have a blowout fight on the way to the altar. Matt fears Patrick will object at his wedding. Narkyia debates ending her relationship with Lowo. Nicole has bad news for Azan.

videos.title: Tell All
videos.overview: The couples from season 4 of 90 Day Fiancé come together for a sit down with Shaun Robinson to discuss all the drama of this past season and reveal what they're up to now on 90 Day Fiancé: The Couples Tell All.

videos.title: Waiting is the Hardest Part
videos.overview: In this season premiere, couples who have their K-1 visa now begin their journey to the alter. Their foreign mates will travel to the US and have 90 days to get married, or leave the country. But some wait in limbo for visa approval.

videos.title: Parental Approval
videos.overview: Evelyn's best friend thinks she is moving too fast. Despite her mother's resistance, Nicole and May leave for Morocco. David struggles to come up with enough money to satisfy Annie's family. Molly's conservative father questions Luis' intentions.

videos.overview: The 90 days begin for 2 couples as foreign fiancés land in America. Before she heads to Ireland, Elizabeth's friends have concerns about Andrei. Azan welcomes Nicole and May in Morocco and is faced with parenting a toddler. We also meet a new couple.

videos.overview: The first morning in America is off to a rough start for both Evelyn & David and Molly & Luis. In Morocco, Nicole and Azan disagree on how to parent May. Elizabeth's lawyer gives distressing news about Andrei's visa. David meets Annie's parents.

videos.title: Family First
videos.overview: Nicole & Azan introduce May to his family. Elizabeth lands in Ireland to news from Andrei. Luis clashes with Molly's family. David meets Evelyn's friends and the night ends in tears. David & Annie have an engagement party. Aika arrives in America.

videos.title: Crossing The Line
videos.overview: Andrei reveals the status of his visa to Elizabeth. Things get heated between Luis and Molly. Azan and Nicole discuss finances. Evelyn & David struggle with wedding costs. Josh wants Aika to model. Annie cries over David's actions.

videos.overview: David and Annie begin the 90 Days. Andrei arrives and meets Elizabeth's dad. Luis questions staying in America and becoming a stepdad. Evelyn & David disagree about where they'll live. Nicole struggles at the gym with Azan. Aika considers going home.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Nicole & Azan say goodbye in Morocco. David's kids meet Annie. Molly confronts Luis about his negative comments. Elizabeth hits Miami for her bachelorette party. Evelyn & David discuss their fight. Josh & Aika see a fertility doctor.

videos.title: Second Thoughts
videos.overview: Nicole returns from Morocco; Andrei confronts Elizabeth's sister; Annie decides if she'll stay in America with David; Aika meets Josh's mom before their Vegas wedding; David and Evelyn finalize wedding prep. Also: a shocking reveal for Molly and Luis.

videos.title: I Now Pronounce You
videos.overview: Molly shockingly reveals that she married Luis; David invites Ashley to his wedding; Nicole gets an update about Azan's visa application; Evelyn and David, and Elizabeth and Andrei get married.

videos.title: Season 5: Tell All
